caption: The drawing depicts a metallic bucket with a wide, flared opening and two looped handles on either side. The bucket features a decorative design, with the main body painted a light grayish-blue color. There is a broad orange-red band running along the top and bottom edges of the bucket, adorned with gold detailing, including geometric patterns and stylized flower motifs in green and gold. On the front side of the bucket, there is an ornate depiction of a classical-style vase containing a large, multi-colored bouquet of flowers, predominantly pink, yellow, white, and red, with green leaves. The interior of the bucket is illustrated as metallic gray, and a segmented, raised, circular insert is visible inside the rim. The handles are rendered to appear metallic, with a twisted rope-like texture. The artist's name "John H. Teracuzzi" appears in small, neat print in the lower left corner of the image. The background is a plain, unadorned beige.
title: Toleware Slop Pail
